allowed_now: Download and hash only the three XCES alignment metadata files.
Parse XML tag names and structural attributes including fromDoc, toDoc, id and xtargets.
Count link groups and links and determine whether stable document and sentence identities are present.
forbidden_now: Read story text or score a tokenizer.
Treat pairwise XCES links as trilingual rows before a closed-component construction is frozen and checked.
advance_rule: Advance to closed-component reconstruction only if all three objects match advertised sizes, decompress and parse without error, and expose document references plus sentence-link identities.
confirmation_rule: At least 512 closed trilingual units will later be required; row selection, tokenizer, vocabulary, preprocessing, metric and cost constraint must be frozen before raw text or tokenization outcomes are opened.
